title: A Wolf for the Spire
author: Jonah Iversen
blurb: Jude Lockridge, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
